{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
sales = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Check for internal test orders (revenue = 999999.99)
internal_test_count = sales[sales['revenue'] == '999999.99'].shape[0]
print(f"Number of rows with revenue = 999999.99: {internal_test_count}")

# Check status values
print(f"Unique status values: {sales['status'].unique()}")

# Convert revenue to float after removing commas
sales['revenue_float'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter completed orders
completed_orders = sales[sales['status'] == 'completed']
print(f"Number of completed orders: {completed_orders.shape[0]}")

# Check if any completed order has revenue = 999999.99
test_orders_in_completed = completed_orders[completed_orders['revenue_float'] == 999999.99]
print(f"Number of completed orders with revenue = 999999.99: {test_orders_in_completed.shape[0]}")

# Compute total revenue from completed orders
total_revenue = completed_orders['revenue_float'].sum()
print(f"Total revenue from completed orders: {total_revenue}")

# If test orders exist, exclude them
if test_orders_in_completed.shape[0] > 0:
    non_test_revenue = completed_orders[completed_orders['revenue_float'] != 999999.99]['revenue_float'].sum()
    print(f"Total revenue from completed, non-test orders: {non_test_revenue}")
    final_revenue = non_test_revenue
else:
    final_revenue = total_revenue
    print("No internal test orders found; using all completed orders.")

# Output final result
print(final_revenue)"}
